name: comicz
description: Plataforma de leitura de HQs e guias para novos leitores

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm-run-all --parallel dev:shared dev:database dev:api dev:worker dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @comicz/api && npm run build -w @comicz/worker && npm run build -w @comicz/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @comicz/shared && npm run build -w @comicz/database
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
